WhatsApp has three upgrades for group chats launching today, including improvements to polls, a way to create new chats from existing groups, and more.

WhatsApp adds new poll features, ‘all’ mentions, and more

Today WhatsApp announced a trio of improvements rolling out for group chats.

Polls are a big focus of today’s updates, with several upgrades launching for polls alone:

  • Voter names can now be hidden so everyone feels comfortable sharing their input
  • You can now set an end time to lock voting at a given deadline
  • Polls can now be edited for up to 15 minutes after posting

Support for @all mentions is another group chat feature launching today. It’s a quick, easy way to get everyone’s attention in the chat. Per WhatsApp:

And lastly, you can now easily create new group chats from an existing group.

If you ever need to spin off a discussion topic or shared project into a separate chat for whatever reason, now it only takes a couple of taps. You’ll find the ‘Create a similar group’ button in the group details screen.

Recently WhatsApp launched support for Apple Music sharing, iPad signups without a phone number, and more.

Are there any group chat features still on your WhatsApp wishlist? Let us know in the comments.
